text: 商务部发布消息，服贸司负责人介绍我国2026年1到7月服务贸易发展情况。2026年1到7月，我国服务进出口总额44467.1亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，出口17732.3亿元，增长17.1%；进口26734.8亿元，增长3.2%。服务贸易逆差9002.5亿元，同比缩小1763.3亿元。主要呈现以下特点：旅行和运输服务出口对整体服务出口增长的贡献率超过50%。知识密集型服务出口占比超过一半。（央视新闻）
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced that a spokesperson from the Department of Trade in Services introduced China's services trade developments from January to July 2026. In January-July 2026, total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. Exports were RMB 1,773.23 billion, up 17.1%; imports were RMB 2,673.48 billion, up 3.2%. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year. Main features: travel and transport services exports contributed over 50% to overall exports growth. Knowledge-intensive services exports accounted for over half of total exports. (CCTV News)
